pumac-2008-finals-a-01.prompt: Find all positive real numbers $b$ for which there exists a positive real number $k$ such that $n-k\le\lfloor bn\rfloor\le n$ for all positive integers $n$.

pumac-2008-finals-a-03.prompt: A sequence $\{a_i\}$ is defined by $a_1=c$ for some $c>0$ and $a_{n+1}=a_n+\dfrac n{a_n}$. Prove that $\dfrac{a_n}{n}$ converges and find its limit.
